description: This Java class defines an Akka actor 'JMSConnectionHandlingActor' responsible for managing JMS connections and sessions, including connect, disconnect, session recovery, and consumer creation, specifically for AMQP messaging within the Eclipse Ditto project.

classes.name: JMSConnectionHandlingActor
classes.description: An Akka actor managing JMS connections and sessions, handling connect/disconnect, session recovery, consumer creation, and connection termination for AMQP messaging.

classes.name: JMSConnectionHandlingActor.ThrowingSupplier
classes.description: Functional interface for JMS operations that may throw JMSException or NamingException.

methods.name: props
methods.description: Creates Props configuration for JMSConnectionHandlingActor with specified connection, exception listener, factory, and logger.

methods.name: propsWithOwnDispatcher
methods.description: Creates Props with a dedicated dispatcher for blocking operations.

methods.name: getOwnDispatcher
methods.description: Retrieves the dispatcher for the actor system suitable for blocking operations.

methods.name: createReceive
methods.description: Defines message handling for connect, disconnect, session recovery, and consumer creation.

methods.name: createMessageConsumer
methods.description: Creates a JMS message consumer for a given session and command.

methods.name: handleCloseSession
methods.description: Handles closing a JMS session.

methods.name: handleRecoverSession
methods.description: Handles recovering a JMS session, including closing previous session and creating new session and consumers.

methods.name: handleConnect
methods.description: Handles connection requests, initiating connection process.

methods.name: handleDisconnect
methods.description: Handles disconnect requests, closing JMS connection.

methods.name: maybeConnectAndTell
methods.description: Attempts to establish a JMS connection and informs the sender.

methods.name: tryConnect
methods.description: Creates and starts a JMS connection, session, and consumers, returning a connected message or throwing exception.

methods.name: startConnection
methods.description: Starts the JMS connection.

methods.name: createSession
methods.description: Creates a JMS session with specific acknowledgment mode.

methods.name: safelyExecuteJmsOperation
methods.description: Executes JMS operations safely, handling exceptions and terminating connection if needed.

methods.name: createConsumers
methods.description: Creates consumers for all sources and addresses, throws exception if any creation fails.

methods.name: createJmsConsumer
methods.description: Creates a JMS consumer for a specific source and address, handling JMS exceptions.

methods.name: createJmsConnection
methods.description: Creates a new JMS connection using the factory, with optional debug logging.

methods.name: buildConnectionFailedException
methods.description: Builds an exception detailing failed source consumptions.

methods.name: terminateConnection
methods.description: Stops and closes a JMS connection, handling exceptions.

methods.name: disconnectAndTell
methods.description: Terminates a JMS connection and informs the sender.
